description: Replace paper account-opening forms with tablet e-forms in every branch. The bank's products and customers stay the same.
Launch an app that connects shops (merchants) with bank and non-bank customers; merchants and customers both join, and the bank earns on each transaction.
Replace standard loan sales with a customised package for each small business — credit line, accounting tools and payments — designed together with the client.
Enter wealth management and insurance under a new brand, competing with fund houses and insurers the bank has never competed with.
Replace physical cheque movement between branches with digital image clearing.
Answer routine balance and card questions with a chatbot instead of call-centre staff.
Run a marketplace where SMEs, their suppliers and several lenders meet; the bank owns the marketplace and earns from every side.
Use customer data to time and word reminders for late payments, replacing manual calls.
Rebuild the loan application-to-disbursal workflow end to end: online application, automated checks, digital sign-off.
